testcase.name: Scenario: Move a custom command into and out of the expanded panel: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:873:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Move a custom command into and out of the expanded panel ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full Tools ribbon is visible ✔ And the Part Tools custom panel target is initially empty ✔ When the user opens Customize from Tools ✔ And the user adds 2D Sketches to the Part Tools target ✔ And the user confirms the customization ✔ Then the 2D Sketches icon appears in the User Commands main panel ✔ When the user right-clicks that icon ✔ Then its context menu offers Move to Expanded Panel ✔ When the user selects Move to Expanded Panel ✔ Then the icon is absent from the main panel ✔ And the User Commands title offers an expansion control ✔ When the user opens the User Commands expansion ✔ Then the 2D Sketches icon appears in the expanded area ✔ When the user right-clicks the expanded icon ✔ And the user selects Move to Main Panel ✔ Then the expansion closes ✔ And the 2D Sketches icon returns to the main panel ✔ When the user reopens Customize from Tools ✔ And the user removes 2D Sketches from the Part Tools target ✔ And the user confirms the customization ✔ Then the User Commands panel is removed
